aboutGame.title: What is Void Runners?
paragraphs: Void Runners is a fast, momentum-driven sci-fi runner built around one question: how long can you keep moving before the void swallows the path behind you? Each run drops you into a collapsing stretch of space where you sprint, dash, slide, and wall-run toward an extraction point while the floor dissolves behind you.

Between runs you build a loadout from movement modules, weapons, suits, cards, and shards, then push deeper into harder arenas and guardian boss fights, solo or with a co-op squad. Our Void Runners wiki gathers the movement tech, upgrade priorities, shard routes, and boss strategies that keep runs alive.

modules.name: Void Runners Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module introduces new players to the core gameplay loop, co-op mechanics, ship control, salvage runs, and basic strategies. It helps beginners understand how to survive early sectors and build effective teams.

highlights.detail: Read the path ahead instead of your character, and commit to a line early.
Bank one dash at all times so a mistake stays survivable.
Master dash and slide before you add wall-runs and grapples.
Take only the easy shards while you are still learning the route.
Spend first upgrades on dash cooldown and momentum retention.
Never backtrack, because the collapse wave is faster than you are.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Void Runners.

items.question: What is Void Runners?
items.answer: Void Runners is a fast, momentum-driven sci-fi runner on Steam. You sprint, dash, slide, and wall-run through a collapsing stretch of space, collect shards, and reach an extraction point before the void closes the route behind you.

items.question: Is Void Runners playable solo or in co-op?
items.answer: Both. You can run Void Runners solo or squad up with friends, where clear roles such as anchor, damage, support, and flex keep the team alive through longer encounters.

items.question: How do Void Runners codes work?
items.answer: Void Runners codes are short strings redeemed in-game for free shards, trails, and cosmetics. They are case-sensitive and most expire quickly, so redeem a new Void Runners code as soon as it appears.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Void Runners?
items.answer: Prioritize movement: dash cooldown reduction and momentum retention first, then pickup radius and a shield or extra life. Score multipliers and cosmetics come last.

items.question: Does Void Runners have boss fights?
items.answer: Yes. Void Runners guardians fight you on arenas that collapse, expand, and drift, so positioning and cooldown discipline matter more than raw damage.

items.question: How do I farm Void Runners shards fast?
items.answer: Stack sources in one session: full stage clears, boss and elite kills, daily and weekly quests, and limited-time event bonuses. Bank the run instead of chasing risky shards.
